ns2:course.label: Medicine and Surgery II
ns2:course.description: Teaches and practice of medicine and surgery of dermatology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, and urology. Surgery and Theriogenology laboratories continue throughout this course. No graduate credit. 10.5 professional hours. Prerequisite: VM 609 and good-standing in the veterinary professional curriculum, or consent of instructor.
